This page illustrates exploratory and descriptive methods
using data from the Western Collaborative Group Study (WCGS)
[@rosenman1975coronary].
@vittinghoff2e [Chapter 2] describe the study this way:

> The Western Collaborative Group Study (WCGS) was a large
> epidemiological study designed to investigate the association between
> the "type A" behavior pattern and coronary heart disease (CHD).
